content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a static site generator that allows users to host their websites and online stores directly from a GitHub repository. This means that creators can upload their digital products to GitHub and link them to their custom domain, effectively creating a free and self-hosted online store. By using GitHub Pages, creators can avoid the 10% fees charged by platforms like Gumroad, which can add up quickly, especially for popular products. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921. With GitHub Pages, creators can say goodbye to platform fees and hello to full control over their digital commerce stack.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Under the hood, GitHub Pages uses a combination of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to generate and serve static website files. When a user requests a webpage, GitHub Pages generates the necessary files and serves them directly to the user's browser. This process is handled by Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script, which are integrated with GitHub Pages to provide additional functionality and customization options. By using these integrations, creators can automate their digital product delivery, configure their payment gateways, and manage their orders and inventory all in one place.
Who This Is Built For and Why

GitHub Pages is built for digital creators who want to take control of their online stores and avoid the fees and restrictions imposed by traditional platforms. This includes authors, artists, designers, developers, and entrepreneurs who rely on selling digital products to make a living. By using GitHub Pages, these creators can break free from the limitations of platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad and build a sovereign digital commerce stack that is truly their own.
By using GitHub Pages, you can break free from the limitations of traditional platforms and build a sovereign digital commerce stack that is truly your own.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components that make GitHub Pages work together include GitHub Pages itself, Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. By integrating these components, creators can automate their digital product delivery, manage their orders and inventory, and process payments securely and efficiently. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the necessary blueprints, templates, and documentation to get started with building a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using GitHub Pages today, follow these concrete steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197), download and review the blueprints and templates, set up a GitHub repository for your online store, upload your digital products to GitHub, configure your payment gateway using NOWPayments, and integrate Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script to automate your digital product delivery. By following these steps and leveraging the resources provided by the Complete Builder Kit, creators can break free from the limitations of traditional platforms and build a sovereign digital commerce stack that is truly their own.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between GitHub Pages and traditional platforms like Stripe or PayPal?

The main difference between GitHub Pages and traditional platforms like Stripe or PayPal is that GitHub Pages allows you to host your online store directly from a GitHub repository, giving you full control over your digital commerce stack and avoiding the fees and restrictions imposed by traditional platforms.
How do I set up a payment gateway using NOWPayments?

To set up a payment gateway using NOWPayments, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account, configure your payment settings, and integrate NOWPayments with your GitHub Pages website. You can find detailed instructions on how to do this in the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
Can I use GitHub Pages to sell physical products?

No, GitHub Pages is designed specifically for selling digital products, such as ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. If you want to sell physical products, you'll need to use a different platform or service.
How do I automate my digital product delivery using Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script?

To automate your digital product delivery using Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script, you'll need to integrate these services with your GitHub Pages website and configure the necessary settings to automatically deliver your digital products to customers. You can find detailed instructions on how to do this in the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
Can I use GitHub Pages to build an e-commerce website?

Yes, GitHub Pages can be used to build a basic e-commerce website, but it's not the best choice for complex or high-volume e-commerce sites. For more advanced e-commerce needs, you may want to consider using a specialized e-commerce platform or service.
How do I integrate Supabase or Google Sheets with my GitHub Pages website?

To integrate Supabase or Google Sheets with your GitHub Pages website, you'll need to create a database or spreadsheet to store your orders and inventory, and then integrate this database or spreadsheet with your GitHub Pages website using API calls or other integration methods. You can find detailed instructions on how to do this in the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
